gaps.quote: Interchanging two fields with growing digit counts is expensive
gaps.note: The page uses "fields" as a data-layout notion (what is interchanged) but neither explains it nor links to a page that does.

gaps.quote: Moving one digit is cheap because a fixed number of scans suffices
gaps.note: The page asserts a fixed number of scans suffices to move one digit but does not say which scans or why; the only worked example (shifting a stream one cell) does not cover moving a digit to an arbitrary place.

gaps.quote: The paper realizes that interchange by computing XOR combinations of intermediate data streams.
gaps.note: The page does not say how XOR combinations of streams yield an interchange of two fields, so the reader cannot check that the construction does what is claimed.

gaps.term: adding them does not change bounds
gaps.quote: So adding them does not change asymptotic bounds
gaps.note: "them" has no referent on the page: nothing before this sentence says what is added, so the reader cannot tell which claim about asymptotic bounds is being made or why it holds.
